project.description:
The terse vocabulary for writing SupirVast `core` IR by hand: constants, vector construction and component access, arithmetic, and the math calls, with the two rules the core algebra imposes handled in one place — a binary operator's operands must share a type (so scalars broadcast), and a zero must be built at a specific type.
It exists because every module that authors IR needs the same dozen helpers, and each was growing its own copy. Nothing here is specific to surfaces, shading, or 2D: it is the layer below all of them, and depends on nothing but SupirVast's core IR.
